evidence.decision: Classifies control versus content surfaces, selects regular/clear glass by background/text needs and avoids duplicated media dimming.
evidence.artifact: Requires surface-role/material map and corrected artifact rather than a catalog of material names.
evidence.transformation: Travel captions move off clear glass over variable photos onto stable reading surfaces while restrained media controls retain justified clear treatment.
evidence.verification: Checks underlying content, scrolling, appearance and contrast/transparency settings; fails lost text/layer distinction or blocked spatial awareness.
evidence.applicability: Preserves platform content thickness/vibrancy, Mac blending context, TV overlay coverage, adaptive spatial glass and Watch modal backgrounds.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Color for foreground roles, Dark Mode for supported transitions and Immersive experiences only when preserving surroundings drives the task.
evidence.distinctiveness: Layer job and actual underlying media dictate material selection and legibility checks.
